answer: One defense is bridge-capped credit. When a cluster of accounts receives nearly all its attestations through a single bridge account that links it to the wider network, the economy caps the whole cluster's rewards at what that bridge alone could earn, and the explorer shades such clusters umber so graders notice them. Honest newcomers gather endorsements from many unrelated peers and stay unaffected, while each pulse of new heads a farm plants still funnels through one link, so its payout stays flat.
